name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: An endless horizontal band with softly fading edges that coasts to a stop when you point at it or tab into it and picks up speed when you leave, with a small Pause button in a header row above it that never covers the band (WCAG 2.2.2). The content is copied just often enough to leave no gap and one copy spans whole pixels, so the loop has no visible seam; the copies are hidden from screen readers and the Tab key, and keyboard focus glides the focused item to the middle.
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)

docs:
Marquee from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { Marquee, MarqueeItem } from "@/components/ui/motion-marquee".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-marquee.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createMarquee on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/marquee/marquee.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#marquee
